decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already captures accounting for coded and randomly assigned rewards, required surfaces, and ticket-commission pairing.
The FAQ already states that no-code mints send a commission and tickets to a random existing NFT holder; the source addresses operational accounting rather than FAQ copy.
The existing no-code feedback text already describes the $5 commission and prize ticket going to a random existing NFT holder, and the source does not change that message.
The source preserves the existing $5 commission per primary mint and changes only no-code reward assignment and accounting details, not the revenue split.
The source confirms that coded-referral rewards remain one $5 commission and one ticket; it does not change this candidate's values.
No-code reward assignment does not alter which referral codes are valid or the self-referral prevention rule.
The source contains no decision about badge content, count, icons, or layout.
Random reward assignment and accounting do not change the rule that each NFT's own mint number is its permanent referral code.
The source does not change USDC payment, approval, or NFT mint-completion behavior.
The source concerns referral rewards and their accounting, not optional tipping or its post-mint transaction.
The source clarifies backend reward behavior and accounting without requesting any change to landing-page hero copy.
The source does not change when mint-success feedback should appear or what transaction result should trigger it.
